note: The one source of every AAC design token (issue 1091). Hand-edited. `node tools/build-design-tokens.js` writes the three copies from it: the Tokens section of DESIGN-SYSTEM.md, the token block in scripts/build_form.py and assets/aac-tokens.css. Never edit a copy; `--check` and tools/design-tokens.test.js fail when one differs from a fresh generation. Colors are hex without the #; contrast ratios are computed, never typed.
